changes.why: `bin/slice` also asks the daemon to confirm the grant, not only the wrappers (bin/slice:5122, bin/rinzler:492). The word `budget` is replaced by what the code does: the tests run on a subset of the granted slots (bin/slice:4263 to bin/slice:4278).

changes.name: DICE_SLOTS
changes.was: `rinzler` and `runtron` read it only when `DICE_DAEMON_CHILD` is `1`. The slots must then form one unbroken run that equals one `--instance` share. An `--instance` in `SYSTEM_CONFIG` that names other slots fails startup. The wrappers and `bin/slice` also require `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`.
changes.now: Every reader except `bin/ci/bench_refresh_quiesce.py` uses it only when `DICE_DAEMON_CHILD` is `1`. `rinzler` and `runtron` need one unbroken run of slots that equals one `--instance` share. `SYSTEM_CONFIG` must hold the matching `--instance`. Without `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, the wrappers start the program without the variable.
changes.why: Three corrections. (1) A missing `--instance` in `SYSTEM_CONFIG` also stops startup, not only a different one: the environment is checked with `require_instance` true (src/system/system.cpp:2097, src/system/system.cpp:1901). (2) The wrappers and `bin/slice` need `DICE_DAEMON_CHILD=1` too (bin/rinzler:475, bin/slice:5106). (3) On a host that is not a shared host the wrappers delete `DICE_SLOTS` before they start the program (bin/rinzler:149 to bin/rinzler:154, bin/rinzler:309 to bin/rinzler:317), so a hand-set value never reaches `gen/rinzler` through the wrapper.

changes.name: DICE_SLOTS
changes.was: The Dice daemon. `bin/slice` narrows it for each test.
changes.now: The Dice daemon. Inside a grant, `bin/slice` sets it for each test.
changes.why: `bin/slice` sets it for a test only when it runs inside a Dice grant (bin/slice:4698 to bin/slice:4700). In every other run it removes the variable from the environment of the test (bin/slice:1708 to bin/slice:1710).

changes.name: DICE_SOCKET_PATH

changes.now: `bin/dice`. `bin/slice`, `bin/rinzler`, `bin/runtron` and `bin/dice-lsf-runner` load `bin/dice` as a module and read it there.
changes.why: `bin/dice-lsf-runner` was missing. It loads the installed `bin/dice` and builds a `DiceClient` without a path (bin/dice-lsf-runner:1195 to bin/dice-lsf-runner:1197). `DiceClient` then calls `socket_path()` (bin/dice:4073), which reads the variable (bin/dice:424).

changes.name: DICE_SOCKET_PATH
changes.was: Unset: in shared Dice mode (`mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`), the `socket` value of that file, by default `/run/dice/dice.sock`. Otherwise `dice.sock` in the Dice runtime directory.
changes.now: Unset: on a shared host (`mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`), the `socket` value of that file, by default `/run/dice/dice.sock`. Otherwise `dice.sock` in the Dice runtime directory.
changes.why: Wording only (`shared host`). The facts are at bin/dice:226 to bin/dice:227 and bin/dice:427 to bin/dice:429.

The Dice daemon runs only on a shared host. Without that override, the daemon removes the variable from the environment of programs it starts.
changes.why: The cell now quotes the error text (bin/dice:397 to bin/dice:400). The removal is at bin/dice:3631 to bin/dice:3645.

They call only `host_config_shared()` and `DiceClient` in the loaded module (bin/rinzler:488, bin/rinzler:491). `DiceClient` asks for the socket path only (bin/dice:4073). `state_path()` is the only reader (bin/dice:433). `bin/slice` reaches it through `dice_state_path()` (bin/slice:5088).

changes.why: The file holds more than the queue. It holds the running, queued and history lists (bin/dice:3923 to bin/dice:3925). `bin/slice` reads it at bin/slice:5393.

changes.name: DICE_STATE_PATH
changes.was: In shared Dice mode (`mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`) `bin/dice` refuses it with an error, unless the test override `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` is active. The Dice daemon runs only in shared Dice mode. Without that override, the daemon removes it from the environment of programs it starts.

The Dice daemon runs only with `mode: shared`. Without that override, the daemon removes the variable from the environment of programs it starts.
changes.why: The cell now quotes the error text (bin/dice:397 to bin/dice:400). The removal is at bin/dice:3631 to bin/dice:3645.

changes.was: Pytest fixtures of the Dice tests.
changes.now: The Dice tests.

changes.name: DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH
changes.was: The Dice programs take the host mode and the socket path from this file and not from `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`. While the override is active, `bin/dice` also accepts path overrides such as `DICE_RUNTIME_DIR` with `mode: shared`.
changes.now: The Dice programs take the host mode and the socket path from this file and not from `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`. While the override is active, `bin/dice` accepts path overrides such as `DICE_RUNTIME_DIR` with `mode: shared`. It also starts the daemon itself and not through `dice.service`.
changes.why: One more effect that a reader needs. With the override active, `ensure_daemon` skips `systemctl start dice.service` and forks the daemon (bin/dice:4147 to bin/dice:4154, bin/dice:4204). Without the override that fork is refused on a shared host (bin/dice:4292).

changes.name: DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH
changes.was: Works only when `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG` is `1`, `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` is set, `bin/dice` runs from a git checkout, and the process or one of its 5 nearest ancestors is a pytest command. Otherwise `bin/dice` reports an error. If `/etc/positron/dice.yaml` has `mode: shared`, `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SHADOW_SHARED=1` is also required.
changes.now: The override needs `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG=1`, a `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST` that is not empty, `bin/dice` inside a git checkout, and a pytest command among the process and its 5 nearest ancestors. Otherwise a set value stops `bin/dice` with an error. With `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, it also needs `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SHADOW_SHARED=1`.
changes.why: `reports an error` did not say that the command stops. `host_config()` raises (bin/dice:241 to bin/dice:249), and `main` prints the message and exits with status 1 (bin/dice:4682 to bin/dice:4684). So a value left in a shell on a real server breaks every Dice command. The other facts are unchanged (bin/dice:288, bin/dice:303, bin/dice:257 to bin/dice:269).

changes.was: Pytest fixtures of the Dice and Slice tests.
changes.now: The Dice and Slice tests.

changes.name: SLICE_BOX_CAPACITY
changes.was: `DICE_BOX_SLOTS` is used when both are set. `bin/slice` ignores both when a live Dice daemon reports its slot count. The Dice daemon ignores both when it starts with `--box`. `bin/dice-lsf-runner` removes it, and `bin/dice-lsf-submit` rejects `--env SLICE_BOX_CAPACITY=...`.
changes.now: `DICE_BOX_SLOTS` is used when both are set. `bin/slice` ignores both when a live Dice daemon reports its slot count. The Dice daemon reads its own environment once at startup. Its option `--box` replaces both. `bin/dice-lsf-runner` removes the variable for the command it starts.
changes.why: Added: the daemon reads the value from its own environment, once at startup (bin/dice:1933 to bin/dice:1935). A value in the shell of a client does not change a running daemon. The sentence about `bin/dice-lsf-submit --env` is dropped to stay inside 45 words. It is true (bin/dice-lsf-submit:1251). The runner removal is at bin/dice-lsf-runner:73 and bin/dice-lsf-runner:1162.

changes.name: SLICE_MANIFEST_OVERRIDE
changes.was: A missing file or invalid JSON ends `bin/slice` with an error message. With `--remote`, `bin/slice` passes the file and the variable to the LSF job. `t/t_slice_catch2_manifest.py` reads the same variable. CI sets it to `gen/ci-test-manifest.json`.
changes.now: A missing file or invalid JSON ends `bin/slice` with an `error:` line and exit status 1. With `--remote`, `bin/slice` passes the file and the variable to the LSF job. `t/t_slice_catch2_manifest.py` reads the same variable. CI sets it to a file named `ci-test-manifest.json`.
changes.why: The exit status is now stated. `open` and `json.load` run without a local handler (bin/slice:1465, bin/slice:1466). `main` catches `OSError` and `ValueError`, prints `error:` and exits with status 1 (bin/slice:7107 to bin/slice:7109). The CI path is not always `gen/ci-test-manifest.json` under the checkout: one job uses `$JOB_TEMP/tron-testRuntime/gen/ci-test-manifest.json` (.github/workflows/gcp-nix.yml:504).

changes.name: SLICE_MANIFEST_OVERRIDE
changes.was: CI workflows. `bin/slice` forwards it to `--remote` jobs.
changes.now: CI workflows and Slice tests. `bin/slice` forwards it to `--remote` jobs.
changes.why: The Slice tests set it for every integration test (bin/slice-tests/test_integration.py:38). `doc/slice.md` names this use (doc/slice.md:617).

changes.name: SLICE_PLATFORM
changes.was: `bin/slice run` exits with an error when the file has no block for the name. `bin/ci/bench_refresh_platform.py` ignores the variable and prints the detected server type.
changes.now: `bin/slice run` exits with an error when the file has no complete block for the name. `bin/ci/bench_refresh_platform.py` ignores the variable and prints the detected server type.
changes.why: A block that exists but is not complete also ends the run. `get_platform_bench` returns `None` for it (bin/slice:2018), and `cmd_run` then exits with status 1 (bin/slice:4228 to bin/slice:4234).

changes.name: SLICE_REPO_ROOT
changes.was: With `--remote`, a value that names a directory other than the checkout of the script ends `bin/slice` with an error and exit status 2. Inside a Dice grant, `bin/slice run` reads `resource-parser.sh` and `resource-map.yaml` from `/opt/positron/config`.
changes.now: With `--remote`, a value that names a directory other than the checkout of the script ends `bin/slice` with an error and exit status 2. Inside a Dice grant, `bin/slice run` and `bin/slice bench` read `resource-parser.sh` and `resource-map.yaml` from `/opt/positron/config`.
changes.why: `bin/slice bench` uses the installed files inside a grant too (bin/slice:2305), not only `bin/slice run` (bin/slice:4242).

changes.name: SLICE_STATE_DIR
changes.was: Changes where `bin/slice` keeps one state file for each `bin/slice` process that runs tests. The files are `<value>/slice-state-<user id>/slice-state-pid<PID>.json`. `bin/slice view` and the cleanup of stale test processes read them.
changes.now: Changes where `bin/slice` keeps one state file for each `bin/slice` process that runs tests. The files are `<value>/slice-state-<user id>/slice-state-pid<PID>.json`. `bin/slice view`, `bin/slice queue` and the cleanup of stale test processes read them.
changes.why: `bin/slice queue` reads the state files too (bin/slice:6034). The other readers are at bin/slice:6465 and bin/slice:4315.

changes.was: Unset: `bin/slice` does not change `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` for the tests it starts.
changes.now: Unset: `bin/slice` adds nothing to the `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` of the tests it starts.
changes.why: `does not change LD_LIBRARY_PATH` was too broad. A CTest `ENVIRONMENT` entry can still set `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` for a test (bin/slice:1700 to bin/slice:1704, bin/slice:1729). The variable only decides the part that is put in front (bin/slice:1731 to bin/slice:1735).
